title: Implement the file-based development task workflow
goal: Provide a bounded, repository-local workflow for selecting and coordinating many development tasks without loading a combined backlog.
scope: Store one validated JSON record per task under a stable area path.
Provide bounded read commands and optimistic, locked, atomic write commands.
Seed project-specific records and connect the workflow to contributor guidance and the roadmap.
Test command behavior, adverse writes, concurrency, deep dependency graphs, and output bounds.
acceptance: All commands and storage rules in ymp-docs/development-tasks.md are implemented with Python 3.11 or newer and the standard library.
Rejected writes leave canonical records unchanged, and two same-revision claims have exactly one winner.
A 1,500-task dataset with a dependency chain longer than 1,000 validates without recursion failure and paginates without gaps or duplicates.
The repository task guide, contributor guidance, root README, roadmap, and ignore rules accurately describe the delivered workflow.
Python and required offline Rust verification commands complete successfully, with external logs and a hash manifest retained for review.
context: Development task ownership is cooperative coordination, not authentication or runtime execution authority.
Independent acceptance and the final done transition are intentionally left to the parent reviewer.

history.note: Implementation is in progress under the owner-authorized development task contract.
